source: Odds: Nexon Korea's published Bonus Stats probabilities (maplestory.nexon.com/Guide/OtherProbability/game/gameAddOption), read 24 Nov 2026. Nexon does not publish them for GMS, so this assumes GMS matches. Values per tier, the flame rules and the 3,000,000 meso reset price: MapleStory Wiki, Bonus Stats and Bonus Stats/Stat Tables (edited 16 Nov 2026), read 24 Nov 2026.

types.name: Meso reset
types.note: Bonus Stats Reset in the Enhancement window: same odds as a Black Rebirth Flame.

oddsNote: Odds are for stages 1 to 5. Flame-advantaged (boss) items count two stages higher, so tiers 3 to 7.
lineCountNote: Chance of 1, 2, 3 or 4 lines from a Rebirth Flame. Flame-advantaged items always get 4.
linesNote: Armour and accessories pick from these 19 lines with equal chance, never the same line twice. ATT and Magic ATT need item level 60+, All Stats % needs 70+.
perTierNote: Each pair is [item level from, value per tier]. A single-stat line gives that much of one stat per tier; a two-stat line gives that much of each. ATT, Magic ATT and All Stats % give 1 per tier on armour.
weightsNote: Flame score counts 1 main stat as 1 point. The other weights are common community values, not Nexon figures. Change them to suit your character.
noFlameNote: Secondary weapons, emblems, badges, rings, shoulders and hearts cannot have flames. Weapons are not covered here: their ATT flame depends on the weapon's base ATT.
